comment: Account plan progress per client group, fiscal year and product family (Account Planning, mv_account_plan_progress; FY2023-FY2026): the CRM plan's original revenue target and mid-year revised target, plan status and owner RM, actual revenue year to date (FY2026 = Apr-Sep 2026; past years = full year) from the gold revenue fact (summed over the group's APAC clients), the same period one year earlier, the full-year run-rate, the bankable wallet estimate with SMBC share of wallet and the top competitor, and the plan's initiative counts. Every group with revenue or a wallet estimate has rows, with or without a plan (group_has_plan). Attainment % = SUM(revenue_actual_ytd_usd) / SUM(effective_target_usd); Revenue YoY % = SUM(revenue_actual_ytd_usd) / SUM(revenue_prior_ytd_usd) - 1; Share of Wallet % = SUM(wallet_smbc_revenue_annualised_usd) / SUM(estimated_wallet_usd). Amounts add across families and groups within one fiscal year. Grain: one row per client group x fiscal year x product family.
